<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular ion is at m/z ≈ 100.0524, which matches the exact mass of the formula C₅H₈O₂ (C₅ = 60.0000, H₈ = 8.0626, O₂ = 31.9898 → total = 100.0524). This formula has a double‑bond equivalent of 2, consistent with an unsaturated carboxylic acid (one carbonyl and one C=C). A common structure fitting this formula is pent‑2‑enoic acid (CH₃‑CH=CH‑CH₂‑COOH). Its SMILES representation is **O=C(O)CC=CC**. This SMILES is valid and matches the deduced formula.</thought>
